slides.en: Misoyushi: miso soup with fresh yushi tofu
slides.body: Soft yushi tofu in miso soup with vegetables, pork and a soft egg, with rice and small sides. The tofu comes from Tamaki Tofu. Yu: it soaks right in, and it's a good breakfast.
slides.cap: Misoyushi: miso soup with yushi tofu

slides.body: Misoyushi ¥950 (large ¥1,050). Miso soup ¥900. Garlic wonton miso soup ¥1,000. Yushi tofu ¥850. Mini miso soup ¥500. Add an egg, natto or kimchi for ¥150, or swap the rice for juushii for ¥100.
